node.statement: Case C_col>0. The reciprocal 1/(2*C_col) is defined, and e<=1/(4*max(C_col,1))<1/(2*C_col): if 0<C_col<=1, the left cutoff is 1/4 while 1/(2*C_col)>=1/2; if C_col>=1, the comparison is 1/(4*C_col)<1/(2*C_col). Together with e<e_col from the preceding child, this satisfies node 1.2 and yields ||U||_{n,1}<=sqrt(2)*q_T(U) for T=P,R.
